source.source: UniMiB SHAR: a dataset for human activity recognition using acceleration data from smartphones (Micucci, Mobilio, Napoletano)
source.license: No explicit license on the dataset page; the authors ask to cite Micucci et al., Applied Sciences 7(10):1101, 2017 (arXiv:1611.07688). Redistribution terms not stated: only small excerpts are kept in testing/fixtures/fall-detection for equivalence tests.
source.scope: Experimental falls and activities of daily living performed by 30 volunteers (18-60 years, 24 F / 6 M) with an Android phone in the trouser pocket at 50 Hz. Not real mountain accidents; no backpack, hand or chest positions.
source.units: m/s^2 in the original files (gravity included, Android device axes); converted to g by /9.80665
source.sampling: uniform 50 Hz (20 ms) verified for every usable record
source.label_definition: fall = main impact (global magnitude maximum) of each fall segment; no_fall = every impact candidate (>1.5 g, first local maximum within +-0.4 s) of every ADL segment. Secondary peaks inside fall segments are excluded from candidate metrics because their label is ambiguous.
source.transformations: Continuous records only (full_data.mat). Records with 4 s recording gaps split into contiguous segments (960 gaps). One trial with NaN samples excluded (participant 9, Jumping trial 2). Conversion m/s^2 -> g. No imputation, no resampling, no synthetic samples, no oversampling or augmentation.

access_audit.MobiAct: Not used. Available only on request to bmi@hmu.gr after signing a database usage agreement limited to non-commercial research and education; no authorised access was obtained (checked 2026-10-22).
